name: Notify Me
summary: Shopify app to recover lost sales on out-of-stock products: back-in-stock notifications, pre-orders and wishlists that keep customers buying instead of bouncing.
best_for: Shopify stores that regularly sell out of popular products and want to recover that lost demand with back-in-stock notifications, pre-orders and wishlists
skip_if: you rarely run out of stock, or your store volume is too low for the recovered sales to outweigh the subscription
honest_knock: It does one job — turning out-of-stock moments into recovered sales via back-in-stock and pre-order alerts — and its value is entirely tied to how often you actually sell out. If your catalog rarely goes out of stock, you won't see much return. As with any Shopify app it's another monthly line item and another script on your storefront, so weigh it against the real revenue you're leaking to stock-outs.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month or $95/yr, first month discounted to $3.96
pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-09-23 against the Shopify App Store listing and notify-me.io/pricing) Four tiers: Lite, a free plan with mostly lifetime allowances, then Kickstart $9.90/mo or $95/yr, Starter $19.90/mo or $191/yr, Standard $39.90/mo or $383/yr, with annual marked 20% off, plus an Enterprise tier arranged by meeting. Each paid tier runs a discounted first month ($3.96, $7.96 and $15.96). Kickstart and Starter carry the same caps (500 alerts, 500 preorders); Standard raises them to 1,500 each, and the listing says unlimited plans are available inside the app. Pre-orders above the plan limit are $0.20 each and $0.15 on Standard; SMS and WhatsApp are priced per country. Kickstart is restricted to Basic Shopify stores in their first year. Lite's allowances are mostly lifetime, not monthly: 100 back-in-stock requests, 5 pre-orders, 50 wishlist actions and 5 SMS and 5 WhatsApp messages over the life of the store, plus 10 notifications a month. 7-day trial and a 30-day money-back guarantee.

compare_with.name: Swym or Appikon Back in Stock
compare_with.why: comparable Shopify restock-alert apps — compare on SMS costs and notification limits at your volume
